title: 29 By ANT
description: An EEG dataset of participants receiving laser stimuli at low and high intensities while rating perceived pain on a 0-10 scale. Each participant completed 4 blocks of 40 trials (160 stimulations in total), with half of the trials at high intensity and half at low intensity. The dataset supports research on pain perception and laser-evoked brain responses.
methods_description: Individual intensities were first calibrated so that laser stimulation corresponded to average pain ratings of 4 and 7. Participants then received a fixed-intensity laser stimulus about every 20 seconds, in 4 blocks of 40 trials. They fixated on a cross with eyes open. After each stimulus there was a 3-second pause, followed by a 5-second window in which they rated pain intensity from 0 to 10. The next trial began 1-3 seconds after the rating.
